execution: Server only; two physical single-GPU hosts, four inference workers each; serialize A100 model/checkpoint loading
scheduling: Shared whole-sample task queue with exclusive locks; all arms for one sample stay on one GPU
phase0: Locate media, exclude all known base/Cue/graph/continuation sample IDs and nine inspected tests; audio exact+PCM, long-text duplicate checks; preserve source-unknown flag

primary_conditions.S: Cue+donor-shuffled Appraisal matched in dimensionality/state-count/length; actual intervention audited

selection: Use new development only to freeze simplest candidate before opening confirmation outcomes. Never select by nine inspected tests or per-test checkpoint.
stop_rules: If content intervention is mostly unchanged, report zero-treatment coverage and redesign before inference.
If Appraisal fails to beat Cue-only and shuffled Appraisal on new material/multiple seeds, do not expand it or retrain it.
If credible independent source grouping remains unavailable, label all confirmation as sample/media-disjoint provisional; do not assert source-independent generalization.
conditional_semantic_phase: Only if initial arms fail to establish a useful method: text-grounded subject/time/target/negation/only/contrast evidence with exact phrase support and abstention; independently verify before expansion
conditional_training: Only after usable separated development and reliable supervision plus a repeatable inference gain; matched no-graph control, separated valence objective, validated semantic evidence, 5000-step pilot; no automatic broad sweep
training_parallelism: Four lanes apply to inference. Training concurrency separately capacity-tested; never assume four full trainers fit.
final_deliverable: Adopt/reject/provisional method matrix, baseline harm, per-class HIT/M, WAF/recalls, OV P/R, uncertainty and data exposure limits
